name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2003 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques for the January 2003 Slammer infection at the idled Davis-Besse nuclear plant: the worm reaching an unpatched server on the plant network and the loss of the monitoring and Safety Parameter Display System computers, from the US-Canada task force's reports and Poulsen's account. No 2003 source prints an ATT&CK id and no ATT&CK for ICS object covers the event: both entries are this study's later mappings. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2003.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior.

techniques.comment: Monitoring computers taken down (task force); the Safety Parameter Display System out for nearly five hours (Poulsen) (basis: Described; a later mapping, since no 2003 source prints an ATT&CK id).
